review.assumptionsToDischarge: Construct the native characteristic-zero Witt coefficient ring with precisely the original finite residue field. Derive Noetherianity and maximal-ideal completeness of the existing actual framed ring and literal equality of its universal reduction with the representation of the original all-weight form. All original local/global residual clauses remain. The constant-coefficient formula is separately checked and retained for the ensuing fixed-determinant compatibility proof.
review.remaining: A characteristic-zero Witt coefficient ring does not prove that the framed ring has characteristic zero or has a characteristic-zero point. All-weight adic association, required local/image/regularity properties, arithmetic automorphy and literal higher symmetric-power continuation remain required. The actual mixed-characteristic cyclotomic determinant lift is the next input to fixed-determinant deformation theory. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
